retentionRules.R01: Retain review identity/source hash and original limitation; stored review is evidence about that reviewed version, not current operational/family acceptance.
retentionRules.E01: Retain original claim/result/failure/provenance. Installed/used/technically complete/owner acceptance differ; no old measured score, NULL/partial cost or outcome rewritten.
